findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_domain" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_domain · Private data: search_domain · Public sink: search_domain, whois_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_domain · Private data: search_domain · Public sink: search_domain, whois_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
